title: nf-core/macproqc pipeline - params.spike_ins_table schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.spike_ins_table

name.errorMessage: Spike-in name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sequence.errorMessage: Spike-in sequence must be provided as ProForma peptidoform (including the charge) without leading or trailing spaces

mz.errorMessage: Spike-in mz must be a number greater than 0

RT.errorMessage: Spike-in RT must be a retention time in seconds (>= 0), or -1 if it is not known

mz-tol.errorMessage: Spike-in mz-tol must be a number greater than 0

mz-tol-unit.errorMessage: Spike-in mz-tol-unit must be one of: ppm | amu | mmu | da

rt-tol.errorMessage: Spike-in rt-tol must be a retention time tolerance in seconds (>= 0)
